## Welcome to my personal website!

<image src="image/headshot.jpg" width="180" style="border-radius:" />

Hi my name is Danielle DeFrancisci.  
I’m a Statistics & Data Science student at UCLA, a Division I rower, and a data-driven problem solver interested in analytics, sports business, and consulting. I love using quantitative tools to understand complex systems, tell stories with data, and present insights clearly through clean design and communication.

My academic and professional work includes:  
- Statistical modeling  
- Machine learning projects in R and Python  
- Sports analytics & business strategy research  
- Consulting-style presentations and client-facing deliverables  
- Public health, environmental, and political data analysis  
- Writing and presenting research to technical and non-technical audiences
